slides.heading: WHY IT MATTERS
bullets: Leading lines guide the viewer's eye through the frame.
They create depth and visual flow.

slides.heading: LINE FLOW
slides.caption: Use lines to direct attention, not distract from it.

slides.heading: HOW TO APPLY IT
steps: Look for natural lines in the environment.
Position your subject at the end of the line.
Adjust angle to strengthen the line.

slides.heading: PRO TIP
slides.text: Diagonal lines add more energy than horizontal ones.

slides.heading: COMMON MISTAKE
slides.text: Letting lines lead out of the frame instead of toward the subject.
